hero.title: CNBC Daily Open: Nothing artificial about 'Super Intelligence'
hero.description: President Donald Trump seeks to rebrand AI ahead of his meeting with China's Xi Jinping, while rejecting a "globalist scheme" to regulate the technology.

latest.title: Iran floats conditions for Hormuz reopening as Trump says deal could come after midterms
latest.description: Tehran's proposal could pave the way for restoring traffic through the Strait of Hormuz, reviving fragile hopes for a diplomatic off-ramp.

latest.title: US Treasury secretary emerges as frontrunner for Trump’s AI czar role: Report
latest.description: US President Donald Trump previously tapped David Sacks as his AI and crypto czar before Sacks stepped down from the role earlier this year after reaching his service limit as a special government employee.

latest.title: Malicious iOS app FomoPeek linked to $580K crypto theft, SlowMist says
latest.description: SlowMist said malicious FomoPeek versions distributed through Apple’s App Store used iOS kernel exploits to escape the sandbox and access sensitive data from other apps.

latest.title: Solana starts testing upgrade that could cut finality from 12.8 seconds to 150 milliseconds
latest.description: Alpenglow would let exchanges, bridges and merchants treat payments as irreversible almost immediately.

latest.title: Bitcoin's on a streak it hasn't hit since 2012
latest.description: Bitcoin’s 10% September gain puts it on track for a rare three-month winning streak last seen in 2012.

latest.title: AI potential to drive crypto demand remains ‘underappreciated’: BlackRock
latest.description: BlackRock says AI agents could drive demand for stablecoins and programmable payment rails, while tokenized computing capacity could create another opportunity for digital assets.

latest.title: Zcash leads crypto majors with a 10% gain as bitcoin holds near $87,000
latest.description: Falling oil eased inflation worries through the Asian session, while a bill to make the government's bitcoin stockpile permanent moved further through Congress than any before it.

latest.title: OpenAI, Anthropic to brief UN Security Council on AI risks: Reports
latest.description: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei and OpenAI CEO Sam Altman are expected to brief the UN Security Council as it examines AI risks and global security.

latest.title: In photos: Key takeaways from day one of the UN General Assembly
latest.description: World leaders descended on New York for the annual United Nations General Assembly, where the agenda covers topics from wars to the risks posed by AI.

latest.title: South Korean solar stocks jump as curbs on Chinese sector expected to remain in place
latest.description: South Korean solar stocks jumped as U.S. restrictions on Chinese solar products came into focus ahead of the Trump-Xi summit.

latest.title: CFTC issues warning over risky prediction market ‘mention’ contracts
latest.description: The warning comes weeks after the CFTC fined a former White House teleprompter operator who made more than $107,000 trading prediction contracts tied to President Trump’s speeches.

latest.title: U.S. regulator warns about cheating risks in 'mention markets' on prediction platforms
latest.description: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission issued a new advisory to flag the unique dangers of markets based on individuals' behavior.

latest.title: Trump administration is examining whether a diesel export ban is feasible, Treasury Secretary says
latest.description: Republican lawmakers have called for an export ban as high diesel prices hit farmers and truckers ahead of the November midterm elections.

latest.title: Here's who we know is going to the Trump-Xi dinner so far
latest.description: Very little is known about which Chinese business executives, if any, are expected to attend.

latest.title: Qantas to start selling tickets next year for its New York to Sydney nonstop flight
latest.description: Qantas plans to start selling tickets for its first New York to Sydney nonstop flight.

latest.title: Lennar shares pop as Berkshire builds almost a 10% stake in beleaguered homebuilder
latest.description: The conglomerate built by Warren Buffett and led today by Greg Abel holds a sizable stake in Miami-based homebuilder Lennar.

latest.title: UN Security Council Will Get Advice on AI Risks From Tech Giants Building It
latest.description: DeepSeek will address the UN Security Council on AI risks this week, sharing a stage with Dario Amodei—who has spent a year calling China's government the industry's biggest threat.
